blueprint_concepts: Position of two circles and the number of common tangents

concept_use.Position of two circles and the number o: The position of two circles is read from d versus r1 + r2 and |r1 - r2|: external touch (3 common tangents) at k = -1, internal touch (1 common tangent) at k = -3.

english: For a non-zero real number $k$, let $C_{k}$ be the circle $x^{2}+y^{2}+2kx=0$, and let $C$ be the circle $(x-4)^{2}+y^{2}=4$. Then the sum of all values of $k$ for which $C_{k}$ and $C$ touch each other is ______.
hindi: किसी शून्येतर वास्तविक संख्या $k$ के लिए माना कि $C_{k}$ वृत्त $x^{2}+y^{2}+2kx=0$ है, तथा $C$ वृत्त $(x-4)^{2}+y^{2}=4$ है। तब $k$ के उन सभी मानों का योग, जिनके लिए $C_{k}$ तथा $C$ एक-दूसरे को स्पर्श करते हैं, ______ है।
solution: External touch ($3$ common tangents): $|4+k|=|k|+2$. For $k>0$: $4=2$, no; for $-4\leq k<0$: $4+k=2-k\Rightarrow k=-1$; for $k<-4$: $-4=2$, no
Internal touch ($1$ common tangent): $|4+k|=\big||k|-2\big|$. For $k>0$: $4+k=|k-2|$ has no solution; for $-4\leq k<0$: $4+k=|k+2|\Rightarrow k=-3$; for $k<-4$: no solution
solution_full: $C_{k}$: $(x+k)^{2}+y^{2}=k^{2}$, centre $(-k,0)$, radius $|k|$ (it passes through the origin). $C$: centre $(4,0)$, radius $2$. Distance between centres $d=|4+k|$.
Two circles touch externally (then they have $3$ common tangents) when $d=r_{1}+r_{2}$, and internally (then $1$ common tangent) when $d=|r_{1}-r_{2}|$.

$k>0$: $4+k=|k-2|$; for $k\geq2$ this gives $4=-2$, for $0<k<2$ it gives $k=-1$, not in range. $-4\leq k<0$: $4+k=|{-k}-2|=|k+2|$; for $-2\leq k<0$: $4=2$, impossible; for $-4\leq k<-2$: $4+k=-k-2$, $k=-3$ (valid). $k<-4$: $-4-k=-k-2$, impossible.
originality_note: New: a family of circles through the origin whose radius and centre move together, compared with a fixed circle; the absolute values make the touching cases piecewise, with one external and one internal touch (way 2, a family analysed as a function of k). Closest known: two given circles touch; find k when one coefficient varies. Different because: both centre and radius depend on k, so the student must split cases by the sign of k and by the type of contact.
stem_review: Read as a student: every point, curve and parameter is introduced, the conditions are complete, there is one reading, the answer is unique and equals the Answer Plan, and the Hindi mirrors the English. Added k non-zero so C_k is a genuine circle. Answer -4 is a negative integer as planned. Changed: k != 0 stated.
key_step: Write d = |4 + k|, r1 = |k| and solve d = r1 + 2 and d = |r1 - 2| case by case.
justification: Standard touching conditions with an absolute-value case split; routine multi-step. Comparable to 2026-P1-Q2 (L2).
